record.question: The sludge does not contain waste water from
record.explanation: Page 3 of the printed paper reads exactly 'The sludge does not contain waste water from' with options bathrooms, wash basins, kitchen sinks and toilets (verified on the PDF image; no underlining or shared directions). The three options bathrooms, wash basins and kitchen sinks are the constituents of grey water/sullage, whereas toilets are the sole blackwater source, so the excluded stream is the toilet waste. Confidence is limited because the printed word 'sludge' is anomalous for this standard grey-water-versus-toilet-waste distinction, so the stem appears loosely worded or misprinted.
